rules.title: Release manifest is debuggable
rules.fix: Remove android:debuggable from the manifest; build systems set it per build type.

rules.title: targetSdk below Google Play's minimum
rules.fix: New apps and updates must target Android 16 (API 36) or higher since Aug 31, 2026 (Wear OS/Automotive: 35, TV/XR: 34; extension to Nov 1, 2026 has passed). Raise targetSdk. Google raises this yearly; re-check the source.

rules.title: targetSdk could not be determined
rules.fix: Confirm your app targets API 36 or higher. Flutter, React Native and Expo apps inherit it from the framework or SDK version; check the generated android/ project or upgrade the framework.

rules.title: Permission needs a Play Console declaration or is restricted
rules.fix: Remove the permission, or prepare the Permissions Declaration Form with a core-feature justification. (Only SMS and Call Log are confirmed as high-risk examples on the Play help page; the rest of this list is from memory and unverified.)

rules.title: Cleartext (HTTP) traffic allowed
rules.fix: Use HTTPS, or restrict cleartext to specific domains via a network security config.

rules.title: New apps must be published as an Android App Bundle
rules.fix: Build an .aab (bundleRelease) and upload that to Play.

rules.title: Native library not aligned for 16 KB page sizes
rules.fix: Apps targeting API 35+ must support 16 KB page sizes on 64-bit devices; updates that don't can't be released from Feb 1, 2027. Rebuild native libraries with 16 KB alignment (-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384) or update NDK/SDKs. Pure Java/Kotlin apps are already fine.

rules.title: Account creation without an apparent account-deletion path

check.what: Sign-up code found, no account deletion code found (heuristic)

rules.fix: If users can create an account in the app, Play requires BOTH an in-app path to delete the account and associated data AND a web link where users can request deletion. Answer the Data deletion questions in the Data safety form.
